title: A tolerant Platform enum
hints: Normalise first: raw.strip().lower(), then cut at the first digit (re.split(r"\d", s, maxsplit=1)[0] or a loop), then " ".join(s.split()) to collapse whitespace.
cls(text) looks a member up by value and raises ValueError when there is none; wrap it in try/except and fall back to ALIASES.get(text).
Put ALIASES = {"macos": Platform.MAC, ...} at module level *after* the class. Try the full text, then text.split(" ", 1)[0]; if both miss, raise ValueError(f"unknown platform: {raw!r}").
